boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named OU spaces for quiet work, group projects, campus organizations, and collection-based exploration.

cards.entity_name: Peggy V. Helmerich Great Reading Room
cards.title: Use the Great Reading Room for silent study
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, 2nd floor
cards.notes: Bring a focused reading task and use this open silent-study room; save conversation and food breaks for another part of Bizzell.
cards.short_summary: A landmark Bizzell room dedicated to silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries lists the Great Reading Room as an open space dedicated to silent study.
cards.access_notes: Located in Bizzell Memorial Library; check library access and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Set up a group work session at HCLC
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 1
cards.notes: Use the open collaboration area for a shared project, or reserve a technology-equipped study room through the library when needed.
cards.short_summary: A technology-enabled Bizzell space for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries describes HCLC as a technology-enabled collaborative space with open collaboration study space and reservable rooms.
cards.source_title: Helmerich Collaborative Learning Center | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Eight collaborative study rooms may be reserved by OU students; availability varies.

cards.title: Combine solo work with academic support
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 1
cards.notes: Choose the Learning Lab when you want individual or collaborative study space near campus student-success services.
cards.short_summary: A Bizzell study area with individual and collaborative options.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries states that the Learning Lab provides OU students collaborative and individual study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located on Lower Level 1 of Bizzell; confirm current library access before going.

cards.title: Take a daylight reset in Canyon Garden
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 2
cards.notes: Enter through Bizzell’s Lower Level 2 for a short outdoor pause, then return to nearby library study areas when you are ready.
cards.short_summary: A public garden accessed through Bizzell’s lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries says the Oklahoma Canyon Garden is available to the public and can be accessed through Bizzell Memorial Library’s Lower Level 2.
cards.access_notes: Use the Lower Level 2 access route through Bizzell Memorial Library.

cards.title: Work around scores, recordings, and student art
cards.subtitle: Catlett Music Center, Lower Level
cards.notes: Visit for arts research or reserve the small-group study room when your project needs a display, table, and chairs.
cards.short_summary: An arts library with media resources and a reservable group room.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries identifies a reservable Fine Arts study room for small groups and a Media Resource Center within the Fine Arts Library.
cards.access_notes: The study room is reservable for small groups; check the library page for current access details.

cards.title: Meet up at the Union between campus commitments
cards.subtitle: 900 Asp Avenue
cards.notes: Use the building’s shared seating and services as a meeting point, and check access rules if arriving after the exterior doors lock.
cards.short_summary: OU’s student union and central campus activity hub.
cards.evidence_claim: OU describes the Oklahoma Memorial Union as a central hub for university activities and a welcoming facility for campus life experiences.
cards.source_title: Visit the OMU | University of Oklahoma
cards.access_notes: The building is open 24 hours daily; after midnight, students, faculty, and staff need a Sooner Card to use the South or East entrances.

cards.title: Plan an organization meeting at the Conoco Center
cards.subtitle: Oklahoma Memorial Union, 2nd and 3rd floors
cards.notes: If you are on an active registered student organization roster, use OU Reserve to request one of the center’s multiuse rooms.
cards.short_summary: A Union-based hub with reservable organization meeting rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: OU SGA states that active registered student organization members can reserve Conoco Center meeting spaces on its second and third floors.
cards.source_title: Conoco Student Leadership Center | OU Student Government Association
cards.access_notes: Room reservations are limited to eligible registered student organization members through OU Reserve.

cards.title: Find campus programs at Henderson-Tolson
cards.subtitle: Norman Campus
cards.notes: Check the center’s calendar or campus programming before visiting, and use the space to connect with educational, social, and cultural events.
cards.short_summary: A campus center for awareness programs and student-group needs.
cards.evidence_claim: OU describes the Henderson-Tolson Cultural Center as a space for educational, political, and social awareness and for university organizations and student groups.
cards.source_title: Self Guided Tour | University of Oklahoma
cards.access_notes: Programming and access can vary; review current campus information before making a dedicated trip.

cards.entity_name: Fred Jones Jr. Museum of Art
cards.title: Make time for the Fred Jones galleries
cards.subtitle: 555 Elm Avenue
cards.notes: Bring your OU ID for complimentary admission, then browse the current exhibitions during posted museum hours before heading back across campus.
cards.short_summary: OU’s campus art museum offers complimentary entry to current OU affiliates.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s visitor page lists complimentary admission for current OU students, faculty, and staff with university ID.
cards.source_title: Visit | Fred Jones Jr. Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.; closed Mondays and university holidays.

cards.entity_name: Sam Noble Oklahoma Museum of Natural History
cards.title: Explore collection-based natural history displays
cards.subtitle: 2401 Chautauqua Avenue
cards.notes: Bring your OU ID for free admission and allow time to move through the museum’s collection-based exhibits during its posted visitor hours.
cards.short_summary: OU students receive free admission to this campus natural history museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sam Noble Museum lists free admission for OU students and identifies its mission as collection-based research, interpretation, and education.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.; verify holiday hours before visiting.
